# Create Progress Bar HUD Text

Source: [wiki article 4527](../archive/4527.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Create Progress Bar HUD Text](../../api/actions/create-progress-bar-hud-text.md).

<a id="wiki-4527-n1"></a>

- Progress HUD text persists until destroyed, uses Last Text ID, and shares text-capacity failure behavior.

<a id="wiki-4527-n2"></a>

- Value is 0–100 percent; higher sort order follows lower; team colors are viewer-relative; non-team spectator visibility is explicit.
